description: Visual element matching (image criterion) on a Windows native app surface, self-seeded: a full-window screenshot of Character Map becomes the template, and a find with that image must match it (score ~1.0) through the real window-capture + template-match + page-source-recovery pipeline. The runCode step asserts the imageMatch output carried a real score, so a silently-skipped match can't pass. Gated like the other charmap fixtures; elsewhere the context lands SKIPPED.

runCode.code: const score = Number(process.env.VF_APP_SCORE); if (!(score >= 0.8)) { console.error('imageMatch.score missing or too low: ' + process.env.VF_APP_SCORE); process.exit(1); } console.log('imageMatch.score ' + score);
